audit_type: Health Ready Probe Classification Repair & Explanation
issue_analyzed: In previous iteration, raw health_ready check output contained readiness failure or missing fields due to script parsing issue, yet overall verdict reported PASS.
correction_applied: Enforced strict boolean contract: health_ready probe verdict is PASS if and only if HTTP status is 200, status payload equals ready, and database status equals ok. Any non-200, timeout, or payload failure must be classified as FAIL.
